questions: Should the histogram be computed for each color channel separately (b, g, r) as in the reference, or should it be a combined 3D histogram of all channels?
What should be the binning for the histogram? The reference uses 256 bins from 0 to 256, but is this fixed or should it be parameterized?
What exactly should be passed to the onpick function? The reference connects 'pick_event', but what data should the event contain (e.g., indices, values)?
Should the function handle grayscale images, or only 3-channel color images? The reference assumes 3 channels.
Is the Axes3D object expected to have any specific properties (e.g., labels, title, view angle) set? The reference does not set them.
Should the function close the figure or leave it open for further modification? The reference returns ax without closing.
What should happen if the image file exists but cannot be read (e.g., corrupted)? The reference only checks existence.
Is the onpick function required to be callable, and should the function validate it? The reference does not validate.
